name: Ector County, TX
findings: Ector County has 239 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ector County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 education organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
